body: Greg's rule (2026-11-03 20:36Z, via Engram::Asistant, verbatim): „prosze zostawcie istniejace ewaluacje w spokoju... OK ?”. No source-identity change rewrites, recomputes, relabels, invalidates, deletes or re-runs a stored evaluation, verification or seal. If a real case can't meet that, bring Greg the facts and options FIRST. The interaction to watch: after a default flip to git-commit:, an open item's evaluation stays under content-v1:, and Engram's exact-string freshness check (Engram src/storage/work/acceptance_evaluation/source.rs:145) would treat it as not fresh if enforcement is on. So before the flip or any evaluation re-enable, list the affected open items and take them to Greg; no automatic reruns.
